payload.reason: The evidence provides specific measures and methods used to evaluate the quality of a Q&A platform, particularly Zhihu Live, through a data-driven approach.

claims.text: A data-driven approach is used to evaluate the quality of the Zhihu Live platform, which includes data collection, cleaning, normalization, descriptive analysis, and predictive analysis.
The dataset ZhihuLive-DB, containing 7242 records and 286,938 comments, is utilized for quality evaluation and analysis of the Zhihu Live platform.
The evaluation method includes predicting the quality of Zhihu Live using a model named MTNet, which has shown superior performance compared to baseline methods.
Consideration of malicious comments and assessments on social networking platforms is highlighted as an important aspect of quality evaluation.
